# UShort 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
UShort:Int32 value:Float32
```

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a UShort, a 16-bit integer from 0 to 65535. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A whole number that is too large or below 0 keeps its lowest 16 bits (`UShort(-1)` is 65535), a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) and stops at 0 or 65535 if it is outside. Use [SatUShort](SatUShort) to stop whole numbers at the limits as well.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The UShort.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print UShort(-1)
Print UShort(65536)
Print UShort(70000.0)
```

```text
65535
0
65535
```
